subject.title: feat(release): preflight all extended-stable npm packages

question: Should the core npm extended-stable preflight accept any exact repository commit SHA and pack every publishable plugin package inside the read-only preflight job?
rationale: The diff changes protected release-operator automation; code review can inspect the guard shape, but release-owner intent is needed for the acceptable rehearsal scope and proof bar.

options.title: Approve after exact-head proof
options.body: Accept the new preflight shape once a linked workflow-dispatch run or redacted terminal transcript proves the plugin tarball artifact path and publish gates remain tag-only.

options.title: Keep plugin proof separate
options.body: Leave all-plugin package proof in the existing Plugin NPM Release workflow and keep the core npm preflight narrower.

options.title: Limit SHA rehearsal
options.body: Allow the plugin artifact preflight only for the selected workflow branch tip until release owners explicitly want arbitrary-SHA rehearsal.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Accept the new preflight shape once a linked workflow-dispatch run or redacted terminal transcript proves the plugin tarball artifact path and publish gates remain tag-only.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the touched release workflow and release-check scripts to this owner boundary.
